correctness.rationale: For h,k>=0, h+k>=1, represent labelled product 2^h×3^k by disjoint set pairs (A,B) covering H⊆X. From (MK) meet preservation, (Pos) positivity and (Con) contact, show each modal unary map separates as m(A,B)=(Box A,Diamond B). Component maps are meet-preserving and union-preserving with Diamond(empty)=empty; each output coordinate is a principal-filter Box threshold P or inactive, and a Diamond neighborhood Q. Disjoint outputs require Q⊆P on active outputs; coverage at y∈H forces P=Q⊆H, yielding 2^h each. At y outside H there are 2^n inactive plus 3^n active choices. Independence yields 2^{h²}(2^n+3^n)^k. Independently brute-force checked all unary functions of carriers sizes 2,3,4,6 (counts 2,5,16,26) against original (MK),(Pos),(Con), corroborating boundary and mixed cases. C relies on analytic coordinate proof for all n, not finite extrapolation.
